name: Crisis Apparition
description: A crisis apparition is an apparition of a living person that appears to friends or family at the moment of — or within approximately 12 hours of — that person's death, serious injury, or extreme distress, despite the person being physically distant from the witness.

aliases.name: Veridical apparition
aliases.meaning: An apparition that conveys truthful information about an event at a distance

aliases.name: Death wraith
aliases.meaning: Apparition of a dying person appearing to loved ones

aliases.name: Fetch
aliases.meaning: Double or apparition of a living person, seen at time of crisis or death

origin: Crisis apparitions have been reported globally across all cultures and historical periods. Systematic collection has focused heavily on the British Isles and Europe from the 1880s onward, with cases documented in North America, Australia, and other countries.
